name: Page Restyle
title_zh: 当前网页就地换装：藏掉指定杂物，加浮层目录
tagline_zh: 广告、侧栏、订阅弹窗不用装插件，说一句就从这个页面上消失；正文重排成安静阅读版式，右侧浮出可点目录。
tagline_en: Say the word and ads, sidebars and subscribe popups vanish from this page; body text reflows into a calm reading.
desc_en: User wants the current http(s) tab restyled in place — hide named clutter, a calmer reading layout, contrast, or a floating TOC.
why_zh: 改的是当前标签页的实时 DOM，不注入持久脚本、不改站点源码，所以只影响这一次浏览，关掉就干净。
why_en: It edits the live DOM of the current tab only — no persistent userscript, no site changes, gone when you close it.
limit_zh: 只作用于当前 http(s) 标签页，且必须由你主动触发；不覆盖浏览器内置页、PDF、跨域 iframe 内部内容。
limit_en: Only the current http(s) tab, only when you trigger it; skips browser pages, PDFs and cross-origin iframe innards, and resets on refresh or.
